title: Lecturers in Public Universities by Citizenship & Sex
description: Number of lecturers in public universities at national and state level, broken down by citizenship and sex.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia for national-level data

fields.name: university
fields.title: University
fields.description: [Categorical] Name of the university, or 'All Universities' for state-level data (for states with more than 1 public university)

fields.name: citizenship
fields.title: Citizenship
fields.description: [Categorical] Either all nationalities ('all'), citizens ('citizen'), or non-citizens ('non_citizen')

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male'), or female ('female')

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from administrative records maintained by the Ministry of Higher Education.
